crossRefs.note: One of the two who heard John and followed him was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted…
One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to him,
Jesus sent these twelve out, and commanded them, saying, “Don’t go among the Gentiles, and don’t enter into any city of…
They were bringing to him little children, that he should touch them, but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing…
But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation, and said to them, “Allow the little children to come to me! Don’t…
John answered, “Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow…
Jesus said to him, “Don’t forbid him, for he who is not against us is for us.”

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Philip
people.line: One of the twelve apostles of Jesus

translations.web: Philip came and told Andrew, and in turn, Andrew came with Philip, and they told Jesus.
translations.bsb: Philip relayed this appeal to Andrew, and both of them went and told Jesus.
translations.kjv: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.
translations.asv: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: Andrew cometh, and Philip, and they tell Jesus.
